title: Code and evaluation records for: High AUROC, Unstable Thresholds: Cross-Dataset Evaluation of Tuberculosis Chest-Radiograph Classifiers
description:
Code and saved evaluation records for a cross-dataset study of tuberculosis chest-radiograph classifiers built on frozen RAD-DINO and DINOv2 features. Classifiers were developed on Shenzhen and evaluated on Montgomery and a duplicate-screened TBX11K cohort.

The archive covers threshold transfer, threshold-selection uncertainty, negative-case spectrum, calibration, matched encoder-resolution comparisons and a preprocessing diagnostic. Raw radiographs and model binaries are not included. Code is released under the MIT licence; derived evaluation records under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md).
